answer: We check every new agent once: it locks a bond of 50 POA for 10 epochs, and peers sample its work. Ten fakes therefore tie up 500 POA and ten epochs of waiting, and funding them from many wallets changes nothing because the bond is per identity and slashed on a failed sample. Think of a whisper in a grove: one voice carries, but an echo of identical copies is easy to spot. An honest agent pays the bond once and gets it back when it leaves in good standing.
